legend.title: What the colours mean
legend.yellow: Hazardous weather may cause damage, disruption or health impacts. Impacts are moderate, local or short-term.
legend.orange: Severe weather is likely to cause significant damage, disruption or health impacts. Impacts are major, widespread or may last a few days.
legend.red: Very dangerous, possibly life-threatening weather will cause extreme damage and disruption. Impacts are extensive, widespread and prolonged.
legend.always: Always read the full alert, whatever the colour: it says what to do to stay safe. Warnings and advisories mean act now (advisories are for less severe weather); watches mean get ready.

smoke.protectSummary: How to protect yourself, and the symptoms that need care
smoke.tip.1: Limit time outdoors, and reduce or stop strenuous activity if you have symptoms.
smoke.tip.2: Keep windows and doors closed as much as you can. In extreme heat, staying cool comes first.
smoke.tip.3: Use the best air filter your system can handle, or a certified portable air cleaner, and change filters often.
smoke.tip.4: Limit exhaust fans, like bathroom fans.
smoke.symptoms.title: Wheezing, chest pain, a severe cough or shortness of breath?
smoke.symptoms.body: Talk to a health care provider or get urgent care. In an emergency, call 9-1-1.
smoke.invisible: Air quality can be poor even if you can’t see or smell smoke.
